steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each permit is placed by its expiry date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 permit expires within 90 days with no decision

findings.title: Expiry within 90 days with no adviser decision
findings.fix: Decide with the adviser this week

findings.title: Permit with no expiry date
findings.fix: Record the expiry from the permit

outcome.notChecked: Whether the person is eligible to renew.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] visa-p01.md:12  Expiry within 90 days with no adviser decision.
       Fix: Decide with the adviser this week.
[medium] visa-p04.md:19  Permit with no expiry date.
       Fix: Record the expiry from the permit.
[low] expiries.csv:26  Adviser decision with no date.
       Fix: Date the decision.
Not checked: Whether the person is eligible to renew.
pros: Checks an expiry within 90 days with no adviser decision, and a permit with no expiry date.
cons: Not checked: Whether the person is eligible to renew.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-visa-expiry-tracker skill on the records for this review.
